editor.helper: Tab leaves the editor. Use <kbd>{{indent}}</kbd> to indent and <kbd>{{outdent}}</kbd> to outdent. <kbd>{{save}}</kbd> saves the draft.

errors.generic: Something went wrong on the server. Try again, and check the TierPlan logs if it keeps happening.
errors.lost: The server didn't answer. The draft may have been saved: reload it before you save again.
errors.permission: You can't save this stack's draft.
errors.tooLarge: A stack can hold at most 50 files and 8 MB in all.
errors.variableName: A variable name is letters, numbers and underscores, and doesn't start with a number.
errors.variableTaken: Two variables are named {{name}}. Remove one.
errors.secretTooShort: A secret value needs at least 4 characters, so that hiding it can't hide ordinary words. Use a longer value, or turn Secret off for {{name}}.
errors.repoFileReadOnly: Repository files can't be edited here. Change them in {{repo}} and pull.

secretFile.title: The content of {{file}} is hidden.
secretFile.body: Secret files are stored encrypted and never shown again. Replace the content to change it.
secretFile.revealDenied: Needs the reveal secrets permission to show this content.
secretFile.revealFailed: Couldn't load the content. Try again.
secretFile.tooBig: Secret files can be at most 500 KB.
secretFile.readFailed: Couldn't read that file. Try another.

stackEditor.readOnly: You can read this stack's files but not change them.

rail.label: Stack files
rail.heading: Files
rail.empty: No other files. Add one for an env_file, a config or a secret the compose file refers to.

errors.path: Use a path inside this stack, without “..” or a leading /.
errors.large: Files can be at most 1 MB.

discard.title: Discard the draft?
discard.body: This deletes the saved draft, including files and variables, and the editor goes back to what is deployed. It can't be undone.

errors.generic: Something went wrong on the server. Try again, and check the TierPlan logs if it keeps happening.
errors.lost: The server didn't answer. The draft may have been discarded: reload the page to check.
errors.permission: You can't discard this stack's draft.

guard.title: Discard changes?
guard.body: Your edits to {{name}} haven't been saved.

conflict.saved: {{user}} saved this draft while you were editing. Reloading shows their version and drops your unsaved changes.
conflict.discarded: The draft was discarded while you were editing. Reloading shows what is deployed now and drops your unsaved changes.

git.caption: These files come from {{repo}} at <mono>{{sha}}</mono>. They can't be edited here. Change them in the repository and pull.
git.captionNoSource: These files come from the repository. They can't be edited here. Change them in the repository and pull.
git.noOverlays: No overlay files. Add one for a secret or config file that isn't in the repository.
